name: Pastel Grunge
summary: Pastel Grunge is an aesthetic that rose to prominence on Tumblr and Lookbook in the early 2010s.
description: Pastel Grunge is an aesthetic that rose to prominence on Tumblr and Lookbook in the early 2010s. This aesthetic takes the edgier, more rough side of Grunge and other more hardcore aesthetics, and combines them with the softer, more romantic and feminine aspects of styles such as Pastel Goth . It is also influenced by the Heroin Chic style of the 1990s, and, as the name implies, Grunge .
